definitions.explanation: Somewhat formal term for a friend from school or university days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学友|がくゆう}です。
examples.english: He is a college friend of mine.

examples.japanese: {学友|がくゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reunited with an old school friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学友|がくゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}っている→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧。
examples.english: I still keep in touch with friends from my high school days.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary term for a friend from one's school or university days. Combines ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (learning/school) and {友|ゆう} (friend). While ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧ or ⟦クラスメート→クラスメート：20969_kurasumeeto⟧ are more common in everyday speech, {学友|がくゆう} has a warmer nuance emphasizing the bond of having studied together.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学友|がくゆう}: university friend
- {学友|がくゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reunite with a school friend
- ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧{学友|がくゆう}: old school friend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧: classmate — neutral, emphasizes being in the same grade
- {級友|きゅうゆう}: classmate — also somewhat formal, specifically same class
- ⟦クラスメート→クラスメート：20969_kurasumeeto⟧: classmate — casual loanword equivalent
